title: main is red (post-merge gate): the data_dir lookup does not know the new cargo build-dir layout

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Main is broken or a regression with no workaround; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## Run

Post-merge gate run 43990986558 (`post-merge.yml`, batch tier, self-hosted Linux runner) on `3f41b8da6b65b8154132878e459d4430e3fb2063` ended `failure`. 199 test binaries report `test result: FAILED` in the `gate-logs` artifact.

## Cause

PR #2293 (`e2ca9443b`) reads posts and machine files from disk at run time (`crates/post/src/data_dir.rs`). The dev candidates (`<profile>/../../assets`, `<manifest>/../../assets`) apply only when `cargo_profile_dir` finds the cargo build tree. It finds the tree only by the old cargo layout:

- the exe folder is `target/<profile>` or `target/<profile>/{deps,examples}`;
- that profile folder holds `.fingerprint`.

The cargo of the runner uses the new build-dir layout. Test executables are in `target/debug/build/<pkg>/<hash>/out/`, not in `target/debug/deps/`. Fingerprints are in each unit folder, so `target/debug/.fingerprint` does not exist. Thus `cargo_profile_dir` returns `None`, and the lookup tries only `<exe dir>/assets/<kind>`.

Evidence from the artifact logs:

```
     Running unittests src/lib.rs (target/debug/build/camcraft-post/4d4a6b2fbedf41a7/out/camcraft_post-4d4a6b2fbedf41a7)
thread 'data_dir::tests::the_dev_run_finds_the_repository_assets' panicked at crates/post/src/data_dir_tests.rs:123:52:
no posts folder found - the program needs its assets/posts directory beside the executable (looked in: /home/ghrunner/runner-work/Camcraft/Camcraft/target/debug/build/camcraft-post/4d4a6b2fbedf41a7/out/assets/posts)
```

Each "looked in" list in the logs has one path only (hash replaced by `H`, count of lines):

```
    424 .../target/debug/build/camcraft-app/H/out/assets/posts
    213 .../target/debug/build/camcraft-app/H/out/assets/machines
     15 .../target/debug/build/camcraft-ui/H/out/assets/machines
     11 .../target/debug/build/camcraft-ui/H/out/assets/posts
      4 .../target/debug/assets/posts          (camcraft-cli, the uplifted binary)
      1 .../target/debug/build/camcraft-post/H/out/assets/posts
```

The last-but-one line shows that the uplifted `target/debug/camcraft-cli` also fails. Thus `target/debug/.fingerprint` is absent in this layout, and a dev run (`cargo run`) with this cargo also fails.

Windows worktrees pass because the local cargo (1.99.0) uses the old layout.

## Grouped failures

1. Lookup (most binaries): the panic text or the refusal names `no posts folder found` or `no machines folder found`. Examples: `post` lib, `shipped_from_disk`, `logging`, `wcs_index`, `rigid_tapping`, `mcp_live`, `lathe_work_spindle`, `ui` lib, `ui` `machine`.
2. Lookup, shown as a different assertion: tests that compare against a shipped machine or post. Examples: `control_comp` and `wear_comp` goldens (the program has `(CAMCRAFT)` and no `M8`, because the default machine is not read), `lathe_workholding_live`, `ui` `machine_mode_tests` and `gate_route_tests`.
3. Not yet explained: `camcraft-motion` `corner_arc_radius` (`Waterline: no corner turned on an arc`). The motion crate does not read posts. The fix of this issue examines it on Windows and reports.

## Done means

- `cargo_profile_dir` accepts the old and the new cargo layout, for test executables and for the uplifted binaries.
- An installed exe without its `assets/<kind>` folder is still refused by name.
- A unit test pins the new layout and fails without the fix.
- The next post-merge run shows no `no posts folder found` and no `no machines folder found`.
